name: XDG Utils with host browser pipe
description: Installs xdg-utils and wraps xdg-open to forward URLs to the host browser through a unix pipe. When the pipe is absent, xdg-open falls back to the real /usr/bin/xdg-open. The host browser pipe itself is machine-specific and must be bound into the container by the consuming devcontainer.json (see the containerBrowserPipePath option); this feature only installs the tools and wrapper.

hostBrowserPipePath.description: Path to the host browser pipe.

containerBrowserPipePath.description: Path inside the container where the host browser pipe is expected. This feature does not declare the bind mount itself (it is host-specific); add one in devcontainer.json sourcing the host pipe to this path.
